item.description: We all but know The Witcher 4 isn't coming out next year. item.title: Final Fantasy IX anime targeting 2028 release
item.description: In 2021, it was announced that Square Enix's hit RPG Final Fantasy IX would be getting an anime adaptation. The studio that was initially signed on to do that adaptation, Cyber Group Studios, shut down earlier this year. However, it seems now that a new studio is taking up work on the series.
